title: Your full-stack app must support offline mode. How would you architect it?
description: Use service workers, local storage, and background sync to enable offline-first experiences.

data.text: **Question:** Your full-stack app must support offline mode. How would you architect it?
Use a service worker for caching, IndexedDB for local storage, and Background Sync to queue mutations when connectivity returns.

items: Cache static assets and API responses in the service worker
Replay queued mutations when online using Background Sync
Resolve conflicts with last-write-wins or CRDTs
Show sync status in the UI

data.text: They assess your ability to design resilient user experiences and handle network uncertainty.

items: How do you handle sync conflicts?
When would you use localStorage vs IndexedDB?
How do you test offline behavior?

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Keep the user informed of sync state
